global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a pink-swirled naruto fish cake. Served in a white bowl with black calligraphy, it rests on a dark, reflective surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, matte surface with subtle reflections and faint, indistinct markings near the bowl's edge.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black calligraphy, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner curve.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl garnish.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled edges.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a glossy surface and irregular, segmented shape.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale yellow, smooth, round with pink spiral swirl on top, slightly glossy surface.
